value.summary: The overlay adds a kernel-bypass compose profile for MongoDB on newer Linux kernels, overriding the mongod entrypoint with a shim script and setting glibc.pTHREAD.rseq=0 on both mongod and mongo-secrets. Nothing in this file is visibly incorrect; correctness of the referenced entrypoint script and matching of service names against the base compose file cannot be verified from this diff alone.
